ggplot-based Coefficient Plot for mvr Models

Source: R/gg_plots.R
gg_coefplot.Rd

Create a coefficient plot from an mvr model using ggplot2.

Usage

gg_coefplot(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvr'
gg_coefplot(
  object,
  ncomp = object$ncomp,
  comps,
  intercept = FALSE,
  separate = FALSE,
  se.whiskers = FALSE,
  labels = FALSE,
  pretty.xlabels = TRUE,
  xlab = "variable",
  ylab = "regression coefficient",
  main = NULL,
  response = NULL,
  plotly = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

model object.

...

further arguments passed to methods.

ncomp

positive integer vector. Number of components used for coefficient output.

comps

integer vector. Component numbers to plot instead of ncomp.

intercept

logical. Include the intercept in the coefficient output.

separate

logical. If TRUE, facet by component size.

se.whiskers

logical. If TRUE, add jackknife-based standard error whiskers. Only available for models fitted with jackknife = TRUE.

labels

optional labels for the x axis.

pretty.xlabels

logical. If TRUE, x-axis labels are thinned for dense spectral plots.

xlab, ylab

axis labels.

main

optional title.

response

optional response to plot. If NULL, all responses are shown. If specified, only that response is plotted.

plotly

logical. If TRUE, use plotly output.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(yarn)
mod <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 6, data = yarn)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gg_coefplot(mod, ncomp = 1:3)
}
